# Code of conduct

Be respectful and assume good intent. Critique ideas and code, not people. Harassment,
discrimination and personal attacks aren't tolerated in issues, pull requests or any other
project space.

This project trains people to serve Medicare beneficiaries well, so the same standard applies to
how we talk about the people in our scenarios: older adults, people with disabilities and people
on fixed incomes are customers to serve, not punchlines.

Report problems privately to the maintainer through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/randallawhitlock/sales-call-simulator/security/advisories/new)
or by contacting [@randallawhitlock](https://github.com/randallawhitlock). Reports are handled
confidentially. The maintainer may remove content or block participants who don't follow this
code.
